_about: How a character learns what an essence does, what an item is, and what was bound into
beside herb-lore.json and smithing-lore.json, whose shape this mirrors so one module
answers all three crafts. Words, prices, times and DCs only; no model authors a number.
Book numbers: identify is DC 15 + the item's caster level, once per item per day, and
beating it by 10 finds a curse (CRB Spellcraft and Cursed Items). Everything else is
the herbalist's and the smith's rows (study by rarity, a teacher's hour, a library's
common knowledge) or the owner's round 4 numbers (a quarter of the motes back on
Unbind). Nothing here is a new house number.

read._pinch: Plan §10: a Read spends a pinch, a tenth of a phial.
read._dc: As study: 10 + 5 per rarity band (plan §10, 'Read and Identify as §12'; §12 sets none, so the herbalist's study DC is the nearest rule).
read._danger: Plan §7.3: 'volatile (Read is dangerous: reading it applies its house drawback for an hour, the forge's reactive-assay shape)'. The essence's OWN first house drawback, never a hazard invented for the bench; a volatile essence with no house drawback is safe to read. Applied whatever the roll says (rules/knowledge.py `apply_danger`).

identify._dc: CRB Spellcraft: 'Identify the properties of a magic item using detect magic: DC 15 + item's caster level', 3 rounds, once per item per day ('additional attempts reveal the same results'). CRB Cursed Items: the curse is found only when the check exceeds the DC by 10 or more.

unbind._residue: Owner round 4 Q6/Q9: the layer goes, the smith's item stays, a quarter of the layer's motes come back as residue, rounded down (no mote is paid back that was not in the item).

teacher._works: No occupation in content/people/occupations.json is an enchanter; the words name the trade.

library._common: What the world writes down about an essence: its plain facts (what it binds, where it sits, what suits it) for common and uncommon ones. A rare essence's secrets and every drawback stay unwritten, as for herbs and metals.

_working_words: None here: the circle's working traits (eager, volatile...) are rendered by the effect vocabulary itself (rules/effectspec.py, lane A), so a second copy of their words would drift.
